ASUS TUF Gaming F16 FX607V - Intel Core 5 210H - RTX 4050 6GB - 8GB DDR5

Dominates the virtual battlefield with the newly designed ASUS TUF Gaming F16 (FX607V series), proudly offered by Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring an expansive 16-inch WUXGA display geared for competitive visual clarity, this powerhouse is driven by the next-generation Intel Core 5 120H processor architecture, high-bandwidth DDR5 memory, and the revolutionary NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 6GB graphics card. Engineered to fulfill military-grade durability standards with dual structural fans for prolonged heavy load endurance. Includes a 1-Year Perfect Warranty coverage policy across Egypt.
